items.title: Webinar: Optimizing Cell Therapy Manufacturing Efficiency with Cryopreserved Cells
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): In this webinar, we will show how delayed isolation and cryopreservation of immune cells from fresh leukopaks can drastically impact their stability and functionality. We will also explore how purified and cryopreserved cell populations such as PBMCs and isolated T cells streamline logistics, reduce variability, and enhance transduction efficiency in CAR-T production.

items.title: Deep dive: Cardiovascular calamities and catalysts
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): BioSpace reviews upcoming cardiovascular milestones after a summer of missed targets.

items.title: Neurosterix nabs $105M, recruits Karuna veterans for schizophrenia push
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Addex Therapeutics spinout Neurosterix will use the series B funds to advance an oral drug targeting M4, a muscarinic receptor also targeted by BMS’ Cobenfy, which introduced a new mechanism for treating schizophrenia with its 2024 approval.

items.title: FDA’s commissioner voucher program reportedly shuttered ahead of Senate vote on Overton
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): In advance of a Senate vote on Heidi Overton as the next FDA commissioner, the agency has shelved the Commissioner's National Priority Voucher program introduced by former leader Marty Makary, Reuters reported Thursday.

items.title: Capricor lays off 10% of workforce ahead of key DMD decision
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.

items.title: Pfizer snags $1.5B financing from PE firm Blackstone to support Metsera asset
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): With 10 active or planned Phase 3 trials underway for Metsera’s berobenatide, Pfizer has signed a deal with Blackstone Life Sciences to finance the program to approval.

items.title: BMS R&D head to depart amid restructure
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Bristol Myers Squibb is combining all research and development efforts under one leader as pressure rises to replenish its pipeline.

items.title: Can we finally get ahead of drug shortages?
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): In this episode of Denatured, you'll hear from Christina Smolke, co-founder & CEO at Antheia and Kyle Pudenz, senior vice president and head of data & AI product at Cencora. We explore why drug shortages are getting worse, and how combining predictive supply-chain analytics with agile, distributed manufacturing could finally make essential medicines more resilient and accessible.

items.title: Blackstone bets $1.5B on Pfizer’s obesity drug
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The deal will support a sprawling Phase 3 program for a monthly GLP-1 shot Pfizer acquired by winning a bidding war for the drug’s previous owner, Metsera.

items.title: Bristol Myers research chief to depart in ‘evolution’ of company’s structure
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Robert Plenge is leaving as part of a shift that will see the company merge together its R&D department in a bid to speed development and capitalize on new technologies.

items.title: The FDA has over 1k open jobs — and the staffing shortage is hitting pharma
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The agency is still recovering from a mass staff exodus last year that left it shorthanded. Here’s what it means for the industry.
